lanren.name: 百年榄仁树
lanren.basis: Trunk position: planting bed in the east side plaza on aerial_campus (dark blob mapped to x 27..31, y 14 through a 4-point homography) and the view geometry of lanshu-1600 (camera on the side plaza near its north steps looking south-west: trunk right of centre, the long low limb running left and towards the camera onto a tall boulder, the wing receding behind). Limb shapes are drawn to match lanshu-1600 (fork at about 4 m, main limb descending from about 3.8 m to rest on the boulder at about 2.7-2.9 m, then turning up) and scenery_13 (canopy overhanging the paving along the wing). Crown extent: Esri canopy corrected for lean, limited to 0.8 m in front of the wing facade. Secondary branches, twigs and leaves are procedural (seeded): they reproduce the habit (horizontal tiers, rosettes of large leaves at the twig ends), not the real branches.

boulders.basis: tall upright boulder under the main limb, about 2.1 m high (lanshu-1600, scaled against the trunk and paving)
low rounded stone beside the tall boulder (lanshu-1600)

groups.basis: two rows of royal palms with white-painted trunk bases flanking the axis road on hero-2560; spacing about 6 m from the trunk positions; distance from the kerb and the first/last palm estimated (+/- 3 m along the road). The Esri layer shows no palm crowns over the forecourt apron, so the rows stop at the forecourt road.
